claim_text: UNEP estimates that 19–23 million tonnes of plastic waste enter aquatic ecosystems each year.

evidence.passage: Every year, 19-23 million tonnes of plastic waste leak into aquatic ecosystems, polluting lakes, rivers and seas.
evidence.provenance_basis: Official publisher-hosted document observed; underlying reporting-chain independence has not been established.

evidence.passage: We estimate that 19 to 23 million metric tons, or 11%, of plastic waste generated globally in 2016 entered aquatic ecosystems.
evidence.source_title: Predicted growth in plastic waste exceeds efforts to mitigate plastic pollution
evidence.provenance_basis: Documented common topic or institutional program; shared underlying origin may exist and independence is not verified.
